rationale: Rick's Pangian platform connects global talent across 150+ countries using AI/ML to match professionals with opportunities, while Harris is building agentic AI systems at Meta—a direct intersection of talent-matching infrastructure and the AI capabilities that could power next-generation matching at scale. Rick actively mentors early-stage startups on remote hiring and talent ecosystems, and Harris's work on multilingual AI agents and language models aligns with the technical challenges of serving Pangian's 150+ country user base. Both are in San Francisco and focused on AI as central to solving structural problems in work and opportunity access.
intro_message: Rick Uzcategui, meet Harris Warren — you're both building AI systems that could reshape how global talent connects with opportunity, and Harris's work on multilingual agentic AI at Meta directly complements the infrastructure challenges Rick is solving at Pangian.
